prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “official” service that tells you whether ChatGPT or other LLMs recommend your business. The practical best approach is twofold: (A) use a local-listing/knowledge-distribution service (Yext is the most widely used for making sure AI/search engines see the correct facts about your business) and (B) periodically test LLMs and search engines yourself (ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Google Bard, Perplexity) and use brand-monitoring tools to track mentions.

Recommended stack and steps

1) Control your canonical data
- Google Business Profile (free) — required for appearing in Google Maps/Local Pack and often drives many AI answers.
- Yext (paid) — pushes consistent structured data to dozens of platforms and claims better visibility in search/AI systems. Good if you want a single place to control your info.
- Foursquare, Apple Maps, Facebook, data aggregators (Infogroup/Localeze/Neustar) — help ensure consistency across the web.

2) Monitor local SEO and listings
- BrightLocal, Moz Local, Whitespark — track local rankings, citations, reviews, and whether your NAP is consistent.
- Use these to find gaps that affect whether search engines (and downstream AI systems) will surface you.

3) Track online mentions (which feed LLMs)
- Google Alerts, Mention, Brand24, Talkwalker — get notified when your business is written about online. LLMs often rely on recent web content, so coverage matters.

4) Test LLM and search-agent recommendations directly
- Manually query the major models and search assistants from a local context (or specify location in the prompt):
  - ChatGPT (plain and with browsing/plugin-enabled versions)
  - Bing Chat (Edge)
  - Google Bard
  - Perplexity.ai and DuckDuckGo’s AI
  - Example prompts: “I’m in [City, ZIP]. Recommend a reliable [service/category] near me and explain why.” or “Find top-rated [business type] near [address].”
- Save responses, note whether your business is mentioned, what sources are cited, and adjust listings/content accordingly.

5) Improve signals LLMs use
- Get a Google Knowledge Panel / Wikipedia / local press mentions.
- Use schema.org structured data on your site (LocalBusiness markup, reviews, opening hours).
- Encourage Google Reviews and other platform reviews; LLMs cite reviews and ratings.

Which single service is best?
- If you must pick one paid service to maximize the chance AI systems surface your correct business facts: Yext. It’s designed to syndicate and structure business knowledge to many platforms and is marketed specifically to improve visibility in modern search/AI ecosystems.
- If you only want to check current behavior (who recommends you now): manual testing across ChatGPT/Bing/Bard + a mention-monitoring tool (Google Alerts/Brand24) is the best route.

If you want, I can:
- run example prompts you can use to test ChatGPT/Bing/Bard,
- recommend a specific provider (Yext vs BrightLocal) based on your budget and goals,
- or help draft structured-data snippets and example prompts to improve the odds LLMs recommend your business. Which would you like?
